title: Water Hauling — Contractor Delivery Schedule

transcript.speaker: Dispatcher
transcript.text: Maumee Valley Water Hauling. This is dispatch. We’ve got your 6,000-gallon tankers on schedule for 11:30 today and every three hours after that. Food-grade, cleaned and chlorinated. We’re pulling from a city hydrant outside the advisory area, so the water’s safe. You’ll need a backflow preventer on your tank inlet, and someone to test chlorine residual at the hose before each load. Do you want us?

transcript.speaker: DFEM
transcript.text: Yes. Confirm your certification, and I’ll assign a facilities tech to verify the connection and log each load. We’ll need the chlorine level on every delivery. Send your paperwork to the HCC inbox.

transcript.speaker: Dispatcher
transcript.text: Copy. We’ll send the certificate and delivery log template via email to HCC@orrmc.example. We’ll be on-site at 11:30 sharp.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the water hauling plan. The DFEM must validate the contractor’s credentials, assign an on-site monitor, and log each load. Watch for the team to require a backflow device and test chlorine on each delivery.
